name: photo-magic
description: One-sentence photo retoucher powered by local AI image-to-image on Intel AIPC

displayDescription.en: One-sentence photo retoucher driven by local AI image-to-image. Swap backgrounds, remove watermarks, change ID-photo background colors, and clean up clutter in seconds.
displayDescription.zh: 一句话修图管家，本地 AI 图生图驱动，换背景、去水印、证件照换底色、去杂物，几秒输出专业级效果。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请将这张照片的背景替换为海边日落场景，严格保留人物/主体的外形、姿态与细节不变，并使新背景与主体光影自然衔接
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please replace the background of this photo with a beach sunset. Keep the subject’s appearance, pose, and details unchanged, and blend the new background with natural lighting

quickPrompts.en: Please replace the background of this photo with a beach sunset. Keep the subject’s appearance, pose, and details unchanged, and blend the new background with natural lighting
quickPrompts.zh: 请将这张照片的背景替换为海边日落场景，严格保留人物/主体的外形、姿态与细节不变，并使新背景与主体光影自然衔接

quickPrompts.en: Please remove the corner mark, timestamp, or overlay I added to this image, and naturally restore the covered area.
quickPrompts.zh: 请去掉这张图上我自己添加的角标、时间戳或遮挡标记，并自然还原被遮挡区域

quickPrompts.en: Please change this ID photo’s background to solid blue. Keep facial features and clothing, do not reshape the face or hair outline
quickPrompts.zh: 请将这张证件照背景换成纯蓝色，保留五官与着装、不改脸型与发丝轮廓

quickPrompts.en: Please remove clutter and passersby from this photo, fill the gaps in the background as cleanly as possible, and keep the rest of the scene and composition intact
quickPrompts.zh: 请去掉这张照片中的杂物与路人，尽量智能填补背景空隙，并完整保留其余画面主体与构图
